transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in today. What brings you in?

I came in because... well, I've been having these episodes with food. After everyone goes to bed, I’ll tell myself I’m just going to have a small bite of leftovers. But then... I don't know, I just keep going. I'll realize I’ve eaten half a tray of catered pasta from work, the dessert from a client dinner, and whatever snacks were in the pantry, all in one sitting. It's just a lot of food at once, and it's starting to really bother me.
After these episodes, do you do anything to try to prevent weight gain or undo what you ate?

No, I don't do anything like that. I mean, I don't make myself throw up or take laxatives or anything. And I definitely don't go to the gym to try and burn it all off. I usually just... I just go to bed feeling really uncomfortably full and guilty about the whole thing. But I don't actually do anything to try and undo it.
How often do these episodes of eating unusually large amounts happen?

For the last three months, it's been... well, there's been at least one night almost every week where I end up eating like this. It usually happens after a late work event, or maybe if I've had an argument with someone. And some weeks, it actually happens twice.
